local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local tag='creator-owned'
local proof=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_AI_PALACE_PHYSICAL_'..tag),'deal receipt missing after save/load')
assert(proof.Attempted and proof.Source and proof.Target,'deal receipt incomplete: '..tag)
local source=proof.Source;local target=proof.Target
local locations=A.NativeWorkLocations(source.Index)
assert(#locations==1,'original disappeared or duplicated after deal: '..tag..' count='..#locations)
local moved=locations[1]
for _,key in ipairs({'Index','GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
  assert(source[key]==moved[key],'AI Palace original metadata changed: '..tag..':'..key)
end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(source.Effects,moved.Effects),'AI Palace original effects changed: '..tag)
for _,key in ipairs({'Owner','CityID','X','Y','Building','Slot'}) do
  assert(target[key]==moved[key],'AI Palace original missed unique recipient slot: '..tag..':'..key)
end
local function currentSlot(city,building,slot)
  local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
  if buildings.GetGreatWorkInSlot then return buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(building,slot) end
  return assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI).ReadCity(city:GetOwner(),city:GetID(),'WORK',building,slot)
end
local from=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(source.X,source.Y))
local to=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
assert(from:GetOwner()==source.Owner and from:GetID()==source.CityID
  and from:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(source.Building)
  and currentSlot(from,source.Building,source.Slot)==-1,
  'AI Palace donor city or old slot changed: '..tag)
assert(to:GetOwner()==target.Owner and to:GetID()==target.CityID
  and currentSlot(to,target.Building,target.Slot)==source.Index,
  'recipient slot does not contain original: '..tag)
local others={}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
  for _,work in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(owner)) do
    if work.Index~=source.Index then
      others[#others+1]={Index=work.Index,Owner=work.Owner,CityID=work.CityID,X=work.X,Y=work.Y,Building=work.Building,Slot=work.Slot}
    end
  end
end
table.sort(others,function(a,b) return a.Index<b.Index end)
assert(A.Rules.Equal(others,proof.Other),'another native work changed during deal: '..tag)
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_PHYSICAL] tag='..tag..' index='..source.Index..' owner='..moved.Owner..' city='..moved.CityID..' sourceEmpty=true count=1')
return 'AI Palace original, provenance and all other works verified: '..tag

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local index=2;local donor=2;local creator=1;local tag='acquired'
local locations=A.NativeWorkLocations(index)
assert(#locations==1,'AI Palace original missing or duplicated before deal: '..tag)
local source=locations[1]
assert(source.Owner==donor and source.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE'
  and source.CreatedByPlayer==creator and source.ObjectType=='GREATWORKOBJECT_RELIC',
  'AI Palace source identity changed: '..tag)
assert(Players[donor] and not Players[donor]:IsHuman(),'donor is not AI: '..tag)
local recipient=1
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI,'UI work slot reader absent')
local candidates=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(recipient,source.ObjectType)
assert(type(candidates)=='table' and #candidates==1,'recipient must have exactly one compatible empty slot: '..tag..' count='..tostring(candidates and #candidates))
local selected=candidates[1]
local target={Owner=recipient,CityID=selected.City,X=selected.X,Y=selected.Y,Building=selected.Building,Slot=selected.Slot}
local targetCity=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
assert(targetCity:GetOwner()==recipient and targetCity:GetID()==target.CityID,
  'candidate UI city differs from Gameplay city: '..tag)
local others={}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
  for _,work in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(owner)) do
    if work.Index~=index then
      others[#others+1]={Index=work.Index,Owner=work.Owner,CityID=work.CityID,X=work.X,Y=work.Y,Building=work.Building,Slot=work.Slot}
    end
  end
end
table.sort(others,function(a,b) return a.Index<b.Index end)
local working=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(DealDirection.OUTGOING,donor,recipient),'working deal absent')
assert(working:GetItemCount()==0,'fixture already has a working deal item')
local possible
for _,candidate in ipairs(DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems(donor,recipient,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,working) or {}) do
  if candidate.ForType==index then possible=candidate end
end
assert(possible and possible.IsValid,'AI Palace work is not an eligible deal item: '..tag)
local definition=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[source.GreatWorkType],'work definition absent')
local item=assert(working:AddItemOfType(DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,donor),'cannot add work deal item')
item:SetSubType(definition.Index);item:SetValueType(index)
working:Validate();assert(working:IsValid(),'AI Palace work deal invalid')
local key='JAC_AI_PALACE_PHYSICAL_'..tag
assert(Game:GetProperty(key)==nil,'native deal was already attempted: '..tag)
Game:SetProperty(key,{Source=A.Rules.Copy(source),Target=target,Other=others,Attempted=true})
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_DEAL_ONCE] tag='..tag..' index='..index..' from='..donor..' to='..recipient..' target='..target.CityID)
local ok,value=pcall(DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal,donor,recipient)
print('[JAC_AI_PALACE_DEAL_RETURN] tag='..tag..' ok='..tostring(ok)..' value='..tostring(value))
assert(ok,'native deal raised after one attempt: '..tag)
return 'issued official AI Palace deal once: '..tag
